conditions.rule: Check for complications after recent termination of pregnancy
conditions.quote: Review the patient who had a TOP within the past 14 days
conditions.note: Recent TOP recorded as the disorder 'Induced termination of pregnancy' (also in VHA vocabulary); 'within the past 14 days' as onset <= time_ago 14 days (Will's convention: <= on onset = within). Assumes the onset recorded is the date of the TOP; TOP is not a common symptom or warning sign, so the rule fires only if the TOP is recorded.

elements_not_encoded.reason: 'Yes' branch label of the post-TOP danger-sign question; encoded by the structure of the priority rule (trigger AND any of the listed signs).
'Manage urgently 182' sets the level Urgent of 'Urgent: complications after recent termination of pregnancy'; the management itself is a pointer to page 182.

judgment_calls.decision: (<= (onset (clinical_finding Induced termination of pregnancy disorder)) (time_ago 14 days)) as task trigger and as first conjunct of every rule
judgment_calls.alternatives: Procedure concept 'Induced termination of pregnancy' (procedure) or a 'Past pregnancy history of induced termination of pregnancy' situation; neither carries the 14-day window

judgment_calls.decision: '(closed cervix and small uterus)' not required as criteria
judgment_calls.alternatives: AND with Cervical os closed and (no Enlarged uterus); would fire less often

judgment_calls.decision: Enlarged uterus OR (Cervical os open AND (bleeding OR products of conception at os))
judgment_calls.alternatives: (Enlarged uterus OR open os) AND (bleeding OR products of conception)

judgment_calls.alternatives: Add (no ...) for each danger sign; would suppress the diagnosis in sicker patients, who are already Urgent
